name: game_new
description: Emit a standalone, buildable game repository under directory/name: workbench.json descriptor, Makefile that includes the shared templates/payload/orbis.mk toolchain fragment, the engine feature pack (features.hpp with fail-closed feature bits), shared internals headers/runtime, host smoke test, and a per-build offsets/ store. Local file writes only; no console access, no deploy. Staging later goes through `ps4-workbench inject` / game_stage, so game repos need no own injector.

engine.description: Engine feature pack to scaffold (default generic)

directory.description: Existing parent directory in which <name>/ is created

title_id.description: Observed PS4 title id, e.g. CUSA12552

payload.description: Payload ELF path inside the repo (default payload.elf)

name: game_update
description: Run the game-aware engine pipeline for the active project as a durable recipe session (unreal_pipeline/source_pipeline, or unreal_update/source_update when old_artifact+annotations are given), register the ps4wb-project-v1 build contract, and install the generated target/offsets/engine headers into the registered repository's generated directory. Console reads only; the recipe's own permission checks apply per step. Resumable via session id.

recipe.description: Built-in recipe name; defaults to the engine pipeline for the active manifest

engine.description: Override the engine (default: active manifest engine)

title_id.description: Open a new project with this observed title id when none is active

app_version.description: Observed application version when opening a new project

name.description: Project name when opening a new project (default: title id)

namespace.description: C++ namespace for generated headers (default game)

old_artifact.description: Previous annotated build artifact; selects the *_update recipe together with annotations

annotations.description: Annotation artifact for the old build (e.g. offsets/<sha>/annotations.json)

session.description: Resume an existing durable session id

install.description: Install generated inputs into the repository (default true)

repository.description: Payload repository; defaults to the registered manifest repository

sdk.description: SDK recorded in the manifest (default: openorbis for unreal, payload otherwise)

staging.description: Staging mode recorded in the manifest (default immediate)

name: game_stage
description: One-call hash-qualified staging: ingest local target/payload files into the artifact store when needed, compute the payload SHA-256 when not supplied, run payload_stage (verify target identity, refuse duplicate residency, upload the ELF once, recover the exported RPC entry), then read payload_status. Requires the process_inject permission and a hardware-qualified payload hash allowlist entry. Never retried automatically.

target.description: ps4wb-internals-target-v1 artifact path or local JSON file

payload.description: payload ELF artifact path or local file

sha256.description: Expected (and hardware-qualified) payload SHA-256; computed from the file when omitted

name: game_verify
description: Actionable game-project doctor: project evidence summary plus per-feature implementation, exact-build evidence, optional runtime-active state, next actions, and optional host-test/cross-build checks. Default is read-only; build checks write local outputs and runtime checks use the payload RPC policy. Host results never establish hardware acceptance.

project.description: Project id (from project_open); defaults to the active project

payload.description: Optional collected-build manifest artifact to inspect

repository.description: Game repository; defaults to the registered manifest repository

pid.description: Optional resident PID used to read active_features telemetry

host_tests.description: Run the repository's host smoke test (writes local test outputs)

cross_build.description: Run the OpenOrbis build for the descriptor payload (writes local build outputs)
